question: The Virupaksha Temple in Hampi, is dedicated to ————.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lord Shiva**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Virupaksha Temple** is dedicated to **Lord Shiva** and is located in **Hampi, Karnataka**, India.
 
• The temple is part of the **Group of Monuments at Hampi**, a **UNESCO World Heritage Site**, renowned for its historical and architectural significance.
 
• The Virupaksha Temple has been a site of **continuous worship** since its inception in the **7th century CE**, making it one of the oldest functioning temples in India.
 
• This temple is associated with the **Vijayanagara Empire**, which contributed significantly to its expansion and artistic embellishment during the **14th and 15th centuries**.
